about.headline: Engineering reliable software for products that need to scale.
paragraphs: I'm a full stack developer specialising in the Microsoft .NET ecosystem. I design and build back-end systems, REST APIs and multi-tenant SaaS platforms that stay fast and maintainable as they grow.
My day-to-day spans clean architecture in ASP.NET Core, performant data access with SQL Server and Dapper, subscription billing with Stripe, and cloud deployments on AWS with Docker.
I care about secure defaults, readable code and shipping features that make a measurable difference for the business and its users.

contact.heading: Have a project in mind?
